jobs.title: Software Engineer, Full Stack
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Norm Ai
Norm Ai, the agentic law company, has a client base with a combined $30 trillion in assets under management.


Norm Ai pioneered Legal Engineering, the process that empowers lawyers to build and supervise domain-specific AI agents with Norm’s proprietary suite of no-code software tools. Norm Ai technology is deployed inside many of the largest and most consequential institutions in the world.


Norm Ai is also the technology behind Norm Law, LLP, a separate but affiliated AI-native law firm built for the era of agentic AI. Norm Law’s attorneys advise leading institutions across private funds, private equity, venture capital, real estate, registered funds, and financial regulation, using the same legal intelligence platform that powers Norm Ai’s products.

AI Fluency:
Norm Ai expects all team members to be fluent in AI. Successful candidates actively use AI in their day-to-day work to support thinking, creation, and problem-solving. They use it to improve the quality and speed of their work and to continuously refine how work gets done end-to-end.

Candidates should be prepared to demonstrate and discuss their AI usage throughout the interview process, including concrete examples of tools, workflows, and outcomes. We look for practical, hands-on experience, not theoretical familiarity.

This Role

We are hiring Software Engineers at Senior to Staff levels. As a Software Engineer, Full Stack at Norm Ai, you'll work across all aspects of our code stack, building intuitive tools transforming legal workflows. You'll partner closely with design, client engagement, other engineering teams, and end users to bring new product ideas to life.

What You'll Do

Software Engineers at Norm typically align to one of two areas. Product engineers own the associate, partner, and operations-facing surfaces of our enterprise application: the workflows, UI, and AI-powered features that make the product indispensable to the Norm Law teams. Backend engineers focus on the shared components and systems leveraged by our product engineering teams, building highly scalable, reusable, and fault-tolerant services, including document processing, AI orchestration, and integration pipelines, in close collaboration with our AIRE and Platform teams.

What We're Looking For

Core Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s in computer science or an equivalent field, or equivalent practical experience

  • 4+ years of experience writing application-layer Python for production use

  • 2+ years of experience writing React + TypeScript, or similar, for production use

  • Experience working with a Postgres database or similar

  • Experience writing APIs using a framework such as FastAPI or similar for production use

  • Interest or experience working with a complex AI-driven product (e.g. streamed outputs, dynamic agentic site navigation)

  • Interest or experience working with PDFs, Excel, or file-driven products

Nice to Haves

  • Experience dealing with database scaling problems

  • Experience building highly configured or abstracted UIs tied to editable schemas stored in a database

  • Experience working with AWS infrastructure or similar

  • Experience working at an early-stage startup

  • Excited to work on product and iterate with customers

Compensation and Benefits

Senior Engineer Base Salary: $190,000 to $250,000 per year

Staff Engineer Base Salary: $240,000 to $280,000 per year

The range displayed in this job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salary for this position. Within the range, individual pay is determined by various factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Equity: Included

Benefits: 401(k) with employer match, health, dental, vision coverage, unlimited paid time off, free lunch in office daily, employee referral bonus program

Relocation: Financial support to ease your move to New York City, designed to make the transition smooth and stress-free.

 

Work Location

Location: New York City

Work model: Hybrid

In-office expectation: 3–4 days per week

To learn more about Norm Ai, visit our website.

We're hiring an Executive Assistant who brings exceptional organizational skills, sound judgment, and a proactive mindset to support up to four Partners at Norm Law. What You'll Do

  • Calendar Management

    • Manage and optimize complex calendars for one or more busy executives

    • Resolve scheduling conflicts and proactively prioritize commitments

  • Communication Support

    • Serve as a liaison between executives and internal/external stakeholders, ensuring timely follow-up on requests

    • Manage, prioritize, and triage incoming messages and correspondence

    • Draft and edit communications on behalf of executives as needed

    • Develop a strong understanding of Norm Ai’s business priorities and how they relate to day-to-day decisions

  • Meeting and Event Coordination

    • Organize and coordinate meetings, including preparing agendas and materials, and capturing and distributing meeting minutes as needed

    • Support planning and execution of events such as conferences and team offsites

  • Travel Arrangements

    • Arrange travel for executives, including flights, accommodations, dining, and transportation

    • Prepare and manage travel itineraries and any related documentation

  • Administrative Support

    • Support office operations such as ordering supplies, coordinating vendors, and keeping common areas well-stocked and organized

    • Perform ad-hoc administrative tasks as needed to support executive effectiveness

What We're Looking For

Core Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree

  • 5+ years of experience as an EA or similar role supporting executives in a fast-paced environment

  • Excellent organizational and time management skills, with a resourceful mindset

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills

  • Proficiency in Google Workspace and ability to quickly learn new tools

  • High attention to detail and accuracy

  • Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion

  • Proactive in identifying and improving inefficient processes

  • Comfortable navigating changing priorities and ambiguity

  • Experience in high growth start-ups

  • Experience planning and managing events

  • Collaborate with our legal engineering team to translate regulatory requirements into practical technical solutions.

  • Bachelors or Masters in computer science or an equivalent field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 4+ years experience writing Python or similar for production use.

  • 1+ years of experience working with enterprise customers in a technical client-facing role (Sales Engineer, Solutions Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer, etc.)

  • Experience writing ETL data pipelines and working with key customer SMEs to map ambiguous customer data into a coherent data model

  • Experience writing APIs, including working with libraries such as FastAPI.

  • Experience working with a Postgres database or similar.

  • Excited to work/iterate with customers.

  • Experience with React/TypeScript and Next.js.

  • Experience with Dagster or Apache Airflow.

  • Participate in identifying and remediating security misconfigurations and hygiene issues across endpoints and SaaS systems

  • Work with security team members to remediate incidents, misconfigurations and hygiene issues

  • Contribute to security-related documentation, including configurations, runbooks, and operational controls

Core Qualifications

  • Proven experience with at least several of:

    • Okta (SSO, MFA, lifecycle management, workflows)

    • Google Workspace administration

    • JAMF and MacOS system hardening

    • Endpoint protection tools (CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, etc.)

    • SaaS configuration management and automation

  • Strong understanding of security principles (least privilege, zero trust, endpoint hardening, patching)

  • Experience implementing and maintaining SSO and MDM integrations

  • Excellent troubleshooting and systems-level thinking skills

  • Strong written documentation and communication skills

Nice to Haves

  • Experience in startup or high-growth environments

  • Familiarity with compliance frameworks (SOC2, ISO 27001, etc.)

  • Automation or scripting experience (Python, Bash, MDM APIs, Okta Workflows)

  • Experience managing Slack Enterprise, ChatGPT Enterprise, or similar collaboration platforms

  • Experience with Microsoft 365, iManage, Intapp, and Litera

  • Exposure to vulnerability management and security telemetry tools

  • Security certifications (Security+, Okta Certified Professional, CISSP, etc.)

This Role

Design the product experience for a new kind of law firm.

Norm Law is the AI-native law firm affiliated with Norm Ai. It pairs experienced attorneys with software to deliver legal work with more speed, certainty, and transparency than the billable-hour model. Lawyers still build trusted client relationships, negotiate deals, and give legal advice, while also training agents and improving the systems that support the work.

We’re hiring a Senior/Staff Product Designer to shape the software behind that model. Much of the work will focus on matter management: how legal work is broken down, tracked, automated, reviewed, and delivered. You’ll design systems that help attorneys understand what’s happening across a matter, what needs their judgment, and what can safely be handled by AI.

Legal work is difficult to manage because so much of it lives outside the system: email threads, document comments, side conversations, client preferences, and partner judgment. The design challenge is to make that work easier to see, track, and automate without losing the trust and judgment legal work depends on.

The advantage here is proximity to a live legal environment. Attorneys, engineers, and designers work close to real client matters, learning from active legal work and improving the system in real time. The path from observation to idea to shipped product can be very short.

What You’ll Do

  • Design matter management and task-tracking workflows for attorneys, partners, and legal operators.

  • Spend meaningful time with Norm Law users to understand how matters move, where work gets stuck, and what needs better visibility.

  • Help define what should be automated, what should be assisted, and what should stay firmly in an attorney’s control.

  • Prototype quickly in code, Cursor, Claude Design, or other AI-assisted tools when that helps the team learn faster.

  • Partner closely with engineering and product from early problem definition through shipped product.

  • Help evolve the design system and product patterns that keep Norm’s software coherent as the surface area expands.

What We’re Looking For

Core Qualifications

  • 6+ years of product design experience shipping real products with strong interaction, visual, and systems craft.

  • A track record of getting close to users and turning messy context into simple product decisions.

  • Strong judgment about when to add structure, when to reduce friction, and when to preserve human control.

  • A build-first mindset. You prototype quickly, test ideas early, and prefer making something real over debating in the abstract.

  • Intentional use of AI in your own process. You use it to move faster and think better, not to skip the hard parts.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience designing legal, healthcare, finance, or other expert professional workflows.

  • Experience with project management, CRM, case management, or systems-of-record products.

  • Comfort with Git, code, or version-controlled prototyping workflows.

  • Has pushed a PR or made a meaningful code contribution outside of a prototyping context.

  • Systems Thinking: Experience building and maintaining brand guidelines, templates, and component libraries that keep a growing brand consistent.

  • Web & CMS Fluency: Working knowledge of a modern CMS platform, with the ability to partner with developers to ship web projects when needed.

  • Collaboration: A strong communicator who can manage multiple concurrent projects, prioritize effectively, and keep cross-functional partners aligned.

  • Mindset: A self-starter who moves fluidly between big-picture brand thinking and hands-on execution, and takes pride in end-to-end ownership.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience building or evolving a brand across two distinct entities, sub-brands, or product lines.

  • Experience with or curiosity about AI-powered design tools and workflows.

  • Familiarity with legal technology or another complex enterprise category.

  • Experience designing for both consumer-facing and B2B/enterprise audiences.

  • A portfolio that includes motion, illustration, or other supporting disciplines beyond core brand and web design.

30 Days

  • Develop a strong understanding of Norm's brand systems, business priorities, and the distinct visual identities of Norm Ai and Norm Law.

  • Build relationships with key cross-functional stakeholders, and audit existing design systems, templates, and web infrastructure.

60 Days

  • Present an initial point of view on priority gaps or opportunities across Norm's design systems and web presence.

  • Independently ship first pieces of campaign, collateral, or web work across both Norm Ai and Norm Law.

90 Days

  • Own a defined workstream (e.g., a design system component, web section, or recurring campaign need) end-to-end, with minimal oversight.

  • Manage multiple concurrent projects across brand, campaigns, and web with limited guidance.

  • Establish a roadmap for ongoing improvements to Norm's visual systems and digital brand presence.

This Role

As a Commercial Contracts Associate (NDA), you will work on a high impact team that provides important services to Norm Law’s clients, while using AI agents to streamline the drafting, review, and execution process in providing non-disclosure agreement review for clients. You’ll collaborate closely with partners, clients, and technology teams to deliver efficient, precise, and data-driven legal services for in-house legal teams of leading asset managers.

Our practice embraces the use of AI to reduce burden and increase your ability to focus on strategic legal judgment and client engagement.

What You'll Do

  • Document Drafting & Review: Leverage AI agents to generate, compare, and redline NDAs tailored to client guidelines

  • Incorporating Legal Context: Work with clients to advise them on their NDA playbooks and provide guidance on market standards, including ensuring AI agents understand each client’s specific context.

  • NDA Execution: Integrate AI agents into workflow management, execution, negotiation, and coordination with counterparties for any NDAs.

  • Client Advisory: Partner with clients to demonstrate how AI-assisted workflows improve accuracy, transparency, and velocity.

  • Collaboration with Tech: Work closely with the technology teams to continue to make the NDA review process even more efficient using AI.

What We're Looking For

Core Qualifications

  • Qualified solicitor admitted in England and Wales, with a current Solicitors Regulation Authority (SRA) practising certificate.

  • 3-6 years of experience reviewing NDAs or similar agreements.

  • Strong drafting and communication skills; meticulous attention to detail.

  • Interest in applying technology to enhance traditional deal workflows.

What Success Looks Like

  • 30 Days: Learn firm AI platforms; begin supporting the commercial contracts team using AI-enabled review and drafting.

  • 60 Days: Independently manage discrete components of NDA review with AI support.

  • 90 Days: Lead AI-augmented workstreams in live NDA reviews, improving efficiency and accuracy in document management and execution processes.

Benefits

Benefits: pension plan with an employer contribution, medical and dental insurance coverage, employee referral bonus program, initial 2 week onboarding in the US.

Work Location

Location: Central London

Work model: Hybrid

In-office expectation: 4-5 days per week

Why Join Norm Law

You’ll be part of the founding UK team bringing a proven US category leader to a receptive UK market. You’ll have autonomy, visibility, and the opportunity to build meaningful relationships — backed by a world-class product, an experienced executive team, and a growing global reputation.

To learn more about Norm Ai, visit our website.
